Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan Expresses Anger Over Demolition of Tribal Homes

In Kosmi village, Budhni, Sehore district, Madhya Pradesh, Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan expressed anger towards his own government after tribal families' homes were demolished and crops destroyed. The action, carried out by the Forest Development Corporation, involved bulldozing the houses of 12 families from the Barla tribal community, filling their wells with soil, and destroying their maize crops.
